title: Conditional-expectation polynomial-time adapter
statement: Let $D$ be a finite, nonempty label set, let a constraint template over $D$ and an encoded-input type be given, and fix binary encodings of the inputs and packed assignments together with a map from encoded inputs to finite randomized constraint-satisfaction inputs. A polynomial-time map on binary strings is an adapter if, on every encoded input, its output is exactly the canonical binary encoding of the packed assignment obtained from the conditional-expectation plan for the associated randomized constraint-satisfaction input.
hypotheses_covered: The label set is finite and nonempty.
A constraint template over the label set is fixed.
An encoded-input type and binary encoding are fixed.
Packed assignments have a fixed binary encoding.
A semantic map from encoded inputs to randomized constraint-satisfaction inputs is fixed.
The algorithm has the specified output on every input.
